answer_summary: X is iodine monobromide, IBr. X adds twice to C18H32O2, and the resulting exact iodine mass percentage is 36.568708...%, which is reported as 36.57%.
assumptions: Reductive ozonolysis cuts an acyclic chain at each distinct C=C bond, so d double bonds give d + 1 fragments.
An acyclic monocarboxylic fatty acid has formula C_n H_(2n - 2d) O2 when it contains d C=C bonds.
Ordinary valences C = 4, H = 1, O = 2, and P = 5 give the sigma-plus-pi bond count of the neutral formula.
Reacting similarly to iodine means one iodine-containing diatomic halogen or interhalogen adds across each C=C bond; the candidates are IF, ICl, IBr, and I2.
Atomic masses are those printed in the supplied problem PDF and are treated as exact as printed.
